title: NASA TPSX Materials Graph
$comment: Schema version 1.2 — updated to strictly align with SOP-DS-001 v1.3 (effective June 3, 2026). Changes from v1: (1) property.value type narrowed to string only (was string|number); (2) property_category enum adds 'environmental', removes 'other' (SOP §6.4 does not list 'other'); (3) images changed from array-of-URI-strings to array-of-objects with image_url/image_data/image_type (SOP §7); (4) top-level source split into separate $def with 'raw' object field (SOP §8.1 v1.3); (5) property-level source uses separate $def without 'raw' field (SOP §6.1); (6) property.raw additionalProperties broadened to string|number|null to accommodate all raw dict values; (7) material canonical_name gains hyphen-pattern constraint; (8) property canonical_name gains snake_case pattern constraint.

material_id.$comment: Always null — assigned by load_to_neo4j.py at import time. SOP §5.1.

material_name.$comment: REQUIRED. Copied exactly as it appears in NASA data. SOP §5.1.

canonical_name.$comment: FIX (was unconstrained string): Must be lowercase, spaces to hyphens, remove specials. e.g. 'Aluminum 6061-T6' → 'aluminum-6061-t6'. Pattern enforces lowercase-hyphenated form. SOP §5.1.

cas_number.$comment: null — NASA TPSX does not provide CAS numbers. SOP §5.1.

uns_number.$comment: null — NASA TPSX does not provide UNS designations. SOP §5.1.

icsd_id.$comment: null — not in NASA TPSX. SOP §5.1.

inchikey.$comment: null — not in NASA TPSX. SOP §5.1.

external_id_type.$comment: null — not in NASA TPSX. SOP §5.1.

chemical_formula.$comment: Extract only if Composition cell content is a formula string with no prose. If cell is mixed formula+prose, or prose only, set null and append full cell to processing_notes. Test: if you cannot copy the cell value directly into chemical_formula without editing it, set null. SOP §5.1 v1.3.

material_type.$comment: Mapped from NASA Category column. null if no reasonable match exists or Category is a database/source name. Record original Category in processing_notes. Log unmapped categories in batch review file. SOP §5.2 v1.3 decision rule.

material_subtype.$comment: Interpreted from Composition/Description if clearly stated (e.g. thermoplastic, thermoset, reinforced). Otherwise null. SOP §5.2.

grade.$comment: Extract only when there is an explicit, unambiguous standalone alphanumeric grade token. e.g. 'Aluminum 6061-T6'→'T6', 'PEEK 450G'→'450G', 'Titanium Grade 5'→'Grade 5'. Chemical compound descriptions and material designations (e.g. PMR-15) are not grades — set null. SOP §5.2 v1.3.

trade_names.$comment: Extracted from Name/Description if mentioned. Default: []. SOP §5.2.

is_variant.$comment: false by default. Set true only if clearly a variant of a base material. SOP §5.2.

base_material_canonical_name.$comment: null unless is_variant is true. SOP §5.2.

properties.$comment: REQUIRED. One property object per property instance. SOP §6.

standards_referenced.$comment: Standard codes parsed from Property_References (ASTM, ISO, NASA-TM). SOP §8.2.

processing_notes.$comment: Assembled from Composition (if not a formula), Description, Notes, TRL, Manufacturer. Each segment prefixed with its label only when non-empty. Suppress segments whose source cell is empty or contains only a parsing artefact (Description:, N/A, n/a, -, em dash, None, Unknown). SOP §5.4 v1.3.

images.$comment: FIX (was array of URI strings): SOP §7 defines each image as an object with image_url, image_data, and image_type. Set to [] if Pictures column is empty or contains non-URL data.

sources.$comment: REQUIRED. At least one entry. sources[0].source_name must always be 'NASA TPSX Materials Database' (long form). sources[0].raw is a structured object. SOP §8.1 v1.3.

supplier_canonical_name.$comment: Fixed mapping from Database_Source. TPSX→nasa-tpsx, K&K Associates Materials→kk-associates-materials, NASA JSC PathFinder Materials→nasa-jsc-pathfinder-materials, NASA Langley Research Center Database→nasa-langley-research-center-database, NASA Ames Thermal Protection Materials→nasa-ames-thermal-protection-materials. SOP §5.3 v1.3.

supplier_product_id.$comment: null — not in NASA data. SOP §5.3.

supplier_grade_name.$comment: Extracted from Material_Name (e.g. '6061-T6' from 'Aluminum 6061-T6'). null if no grade token. SOP §5.3.

datasheet_url.$comment: Copy URL column value as-is — always a MaterialDetail URL (https://tpsx.arc.nasa.gov/MaterialDetail?id=N). Do not construct or modify. SOP §5.3 v1.3.

name.$comment: Human-readable property name with spaces. e.g. 'Density', 'Tensile Strength Isotropic'. SOP §6.1.

canonical_name.$comment: FIX (was unconstrained string): Must be snake_case — lowercase, spaces to underscores, possessive apostrophes dropped. e.g. tensile_strength_isotropic, youngs_modulus, poissons_ratio. Pattern enforces snake_case form. SOP §6.3.

value.$comment: FIX (was type ['string','number']): ALWAYS a string — SOP §6.2 v1.3 states value is 'always a string'. Preserve the string as pandas produces it (e.g. '2.7', '288.0', '83400000.0'). Do not reformat to scientific notation. Ranges like '40-60' copied as string. numeric_value carries the actual numeric for downstream use.

numeric_value.$comment: Parsed float/int from value, or null if value is non-numeric (range, text). SOP §6.2.

unit.$comment: From _Units column. null if column absent. SOP §6.2.

condition.$comment: Constructed from STP mapping (STP→'STP', No→'Non-STP', nonstp→'Non-STP', assumed/assumed→'assumed STP', absent→null) plus instance label when same base property appears more than once in the row (count-based, not suffix-based). e.g. 'Non-STP, Instance 1'. null if single occurrence and no STP. SOP §6.2 v1.3, §6.5 v1.3.

property_category.$comment: FIX (was missing 'environmental', had 'other'): SOP §6.4 defines exactly these 8 categories. 'environmental' covers Effective_Heat_of_Ablation, Char_Yield, Pyrolysis_Gas_Enthalpy. 'other' is not a valid SOP category and has been removed.

raw.$comment: FIX (was additionalProperties: string only): Values can be strings, numbers (e.g. instance numbers), or null. However per SOP §10 v1.1 the key-omission rule applies: if a source CSV cell is empty or a suppressed artefact, omit the key entirely from raw — do NOT set the key to null. null here means the entire raw object is absent, not that individual keys hold null values.

source.$comment: FIX (was shared source def which included 'raw' field): Property-level source has no 'raw' field. Only top-level sources[] have raw. SOP §6.1.

image.$comment: FIX (images was array of URI strings): SOP §7 defines each entry as an object with these three fields.

image_url.$comment: URL extracted from Pictures column. One object per URL. SOP §7.

image_data.$comment: Always null — binary data is not in the CSV export. SOP §7.

image_type.$comment: null unless type is determinable (e.g. 'microstructure'). SOP §7.

property_source.$comment: FIX: Property-level source definition — intentionally excludes 'raw' field. The shared source def in v1 allowed 'raw' on property sources, which is incorrect. SOP §6.1 shows property.source has only source_name, source_url, doi, tier.

source_name.$comment: Two-level rule: use _Source column value if it is a named external standard (ASTM XXXX, ISO XXX-X, NASA-TM-XXXX, NASA-CR-XXXX). Otherwise 'NASA TPSX' (short form). Generic values like 'measured', 'TPSX Database', blank → fall back to 'NASA TPSX'. SOP §6.1 v1.2, §6.2.

source_url.$comment: URL column value — always the MaterialDetail URL. Same value used for all URL fields. SOP §5.3 v1.3.

tier.$comment: tier1 for all NASA TPSX data. SOP §8.

top_level_source.$comment: FIX (was shared def with raw as string|null): Top-level sources[] entry. Differs from property_source by (a) source_name must use the long form 'NASA TPSX Materials Database', and (b) has an optional 'raw' object field for General_References, Point_of_Contact, Last_Modified. SOP §8.1 v1.3.

source_name.$comment: MUST use long form: 'NASA TPSX Materials Database'. Never the short form 'NASA TPSX' at this level. SOP §8.1 v1.3.

source_url.$comment: URL column value — MaterialDetail URL. SOP §5.3 v1.3.

General_References.$comment: Include if non-empty and not a suppressed artefact. Omit key entirely if empty. SOP §8.1 v1.3.

Point_of_Contact.$comment: Include if non-empty and not a suppressed artefact. Omit key entirely if empty. SOP §8.1 v1.3.

Last_Modified.$comment: Include if non-empty and not a suppressed artefact. Omit key entirely if empty. SOP §8.1 v1.3.

raw.$comment: FIX (was type string|null): Structured object with exactly three optional keys. Apply key-omission rule: omit any key whose CSV cell is empty or a suppressed artefact (Description:, N/A, n/a, -, em dash, None, Unknown). If all three cells are empty/artefact, omit the raw field entirely (set to null). SOP §8.1 v1.3.
